scope: Evidence patch formatting only; runtime and prior test results unchanged
cause: git diff --cached --check flagged a single-space blank context line inside the archived unified diff; source files were clean. The shell continued to commit/push, so that formatting failure is preserved here.
repair: Regenerated the exact three-file diff with zero context; no source changes and no whitespace checker relaxed.
verification: Applied using git apply --unidiff-zero in a disposable directory initialized from the parent source; all three resulting files byte-match the tested source.
